headline: Heroes go nuclear, Goons file a missing-persons report
dek: Hail Mary Heroes 158.0 — the week's high score and a personal attack on anyone who sat a running back.
body: Week 13: Hail Mary Heroes 158.0, Gridiron Goons 90.0. That is not a football score so much as a weather event. End Zone Enforcers 144.7 beat Turf Titans 120.6 in the other room, which would have been the lede in a quieter league.
If you streamed a defense and felt clever, Heroes would like a word. If you are the Goons, maybe don't.
Power rankings below, computed the boring way (all-play), written the usual way (mean).

ranking_copy.blurb: Heroes at 158.0. When the high score and the blowout are the same team, the column writes itself and then takes the rest of the night off.
Enforcers 144.7 — second banana on a week when second banana still cleared most of the league's season average.
Titans lost 120.6–144.7 and will tell you they 'kept it close' in the sense that both teams used a football.
Goons, 90.0. The bench was not the problem. The problem was also the bench.
